title: Paying Approved Redemptions of Class H Preferred Stock — Member Equities & Patronage Servicing Standard and Platform Reference
content:
An approved Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock redemption whose notice period has run is paid by the servicing desk out of the holding, at par.

## Rule

1. An approved Class H Preferred Stock redemption whose notice period has run is paid within the class's retirement processing period in calendar days of the written request, by the payout method on the holding, as one retirement entry with reason redemption dated the day it is paid; the board limits what it pays on redemptions in each calendar quarter.
2. The amount paid on an approved redemption is fixed only after the holding carries the reinvested dividend for every quarter whose dividend payment date has passed.
3. The part of an approved request above the quarter's redemption allowance is not paid; the holding returns to active status with its remaining shares, and the member may ask again in writing.
4. A holding without an approved preferred redemption request whose notice period has run has nothing paid under this rule.

## Business effect

A retirement entry with reason redemption is recorded for the par amount paid, effective the day it is paid, and the proceeds go by the payout method on the holding — direct deposit to the account on file, otherwise check. The holding's balance falls by the amount and the pending redemption request date is cleared; the holding returns to active status when a balance remains, or is closed as retired when the balance reaches zero. The member can then see the redemption entry and the new balance.

## Platform reference: `pay_preferred_redemption_7befd982`

**Capability.** Pays out an approved Class H Preferred Stock redemption and records the shares retired at par: one retirement entry with reason redemption for the par amount given, effective today.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the servicing representative unlocks `pay_preferred_redemption_7befd982` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `equity_id` | The reference number of the member's Class H Preferred Stock holding, read from the member's equity holdings lookup | Identifier, text |
| `amount` | The par value of the shares redeemed and paid | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** On success a receipt with `status` "paid"; `eq_txn_id`, the reference of the new redemption entry (text); `equity_id`, the holding paid from (text); `amount`, the USD redeemed at par (2 decimal places); `payment_method`, how the proceeds were sent — `direct_deposit` or `check`; `new_balance`, the holding's balance afterwards (USD, 2 decimal places); and `holding_status` — `active` when shares remain, `retired` when none remain.

## Contract questions

**Which date does the redemption entry carry?** Today, the day it is paid.

**Who chooses between direct deposit and check?** Neither parameter does: the method follows the payout method on the holding — direct deposit when the holding is set to direct deposit, otherwise check.
